state.$description: Opacities of interaction states that components apply themselves. A hover, focus or pressed state is a state layer: the component's content color at its opacity over its container, as Material draws them, so a component given its own colors keeps working states. The semantic hover and pressed tokens (color.bg, color.fg, color.border) stay for the solid fills and navigation fills a layer can't match, and for applications.

hover-opacity.$description: The state layer under the pointer: 8% of the content color over the container.

focus-opacity.$description: The state layer of keyboard focus, under the focus ring: 10% of the content color.

pressed-opacity.$description: The state layer while pressed: 10% of the content color over the container.
